source: Written 2026-10-14 from the verified Scryfall oracle text fetched that day and this deck's notes (the Bartolomé lattice: recursion enchantment + returner + the commander as a free outlet). Every loop shown is traced step by step from those texts. Cards a caption names are [[bracketed]] so clips.py checks them against the current list. Opponents' cards are placeholders, never named.

scenes.head: [[Bartolomé del Presidio]] — 600 Infinite Combos
scenes.sub: A free sacrifice outlet that starts in the command zone.
scenes.say: [[Bartolomé del Presidio]]: six hundred infinite combos. A free sacrifice outlet that starts in the command zone.

scenes.head: His one line
scenes.sub: Sacrifice another creature or artifact: put a +1/+1 counter on him. No mana, no tapping, no once-per-turn limit.
scenes.say: His one line: sacrifice another creature or artifact, and put a plus one plus one counter on him. No mana, no tapping, and no once-per-turn limit.

scenes.head: Half one: bring the creature back
scenes.sub: Seven enchantments return a creature to the battlefield when it dies.

scenes.head: Half two: bring the enchantment back
scenes.sub: Seven creatures whose enter trigger can return that card from your graveyard to the battlefield.

scenes.head: Sacrifice. Return. Return. Forever.
scenes.sub: One card from each half, plus Bartolomé, loops for zero mana. This list holds 44 working pairs.
scenes.say: Sacrifice, return, return, forever. One card from each half, plus Bartolomé, loops for zero mana. This list holds forty-four working pairs.

scenes.head: Add one payoff and it's a kill
scenes.sub: Six cards turn every trip around the loop into lost life or milled cards.

scenes.head: Learn the loop. Assemble it. Close it out.
scenes.sub: Three clips follow, one for each.

scenes.head: Turn 2: [[Bartolomé del Presidio|Bartolomé]]
scenes.sub: {W}{B}, cast from the command zone.
scenes.say: Turn two: cast [[Bartolomé del Presidio|Bartolomé]] from the command zone, for white and black.

scenes.head: Turn 4: [[Brotherhood Outcast]]
scenes.sub: {2}{W}. Its enter trigger is modal. No Aura is in your graveyard yet, so take the other mode: a shield counter on Bartolomé.
scenes.say: Turn four: [[Brotherhood Outcast]], for three mana. Its enter trigger is modal. There's no Aura in your graveyard yet, so take the other mode, and put a shield counter on Bartolomé.

scenes.head: [[Kaya's Ghostform]] on [[Brotherhood Outcast|Outcast]]
scenes.sub: {B}. When enchanted permanent dies or is put into exile, return that card to the battlefield under your control.
scenes.say: Then [[Kaya's Ghostform]] on Outcast, for one black. When the enchanted permanent dies or is put into exile, return that card to the battlefield under your control.

scenes.head: Step 1: sacrifice [[Brotherhood Outcast|Outcast]] to [[Bartolomé del Presidio|Bartolomé]]
scenes.sub: No mana. Bartolomé gets a +1/+1 counter. Outcast dies, and Ghostform follows it to the graveyard.
scenes.say: Step one: sacrifice Outcast to Bartolomé. No mana. Bartolomé gets a plus one plus one counter. Outcast dies, and Ghostform follows it to the graveyard.

scenes.head: Step 2: [[Kaya's Ghostform|Ghostform]] returns Outcast
scenes.sub: Its trigger puts that card back onto the battlefield under your control.

scenes.head: Step 3: [[Brotherhood Outcast|Outcast]] returns Ghostform
scenes.sub: Enter trigger: return target Aura with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Ghostform's is 1, so it goes back on Outcast.

scenes.head: Back to the start, one counter up
scenes.sub: Same board, no mana spent. Repeat at will: each trip is a death and a +1/+1 counter.
scenes.say: Back to the start, one counter up. Same board, no mana spent. Repeat at will: each trip is a death, and a plus one plus one counter.

scenes.head: Swap in any pair
scenes.sub: [[Sun Titan]] + [[Angelic Renewal]]: sacrifice Titan, Renewal sacrifices itself to return it, and Titan's enter trigger returns Renewal (mana value 2).
scenes.say: Swap in any pair. [[Sun Titan]] and [[Angelic Renewal]]: sacrifice Titan, Renewal sacrifices itself to return it, and Titan's enter trigger returns Renewal, which has mana value two.

scenes.head: Check the gates
scenes.sub: [[Shepherd of the Cosmos]] only reaches mana value 2. [[Brotherhood Outcast|Outcast]], [[Danitha, Benalia's Hope|Danitha]] and [[Boonweaver Giant|Boonweaver]] return Auras; [[Angelic Renewal]] isn't one. [[Redemption Choir]] needs three creatures with different powers.

scenes.head: Fill the graveyard, then feed Bartolomé
scenes.sub: [[Stitcher's Supplier]] and [[Crow of Dark Tidings]] mill when they enter and again when they die. [[Undead Butler]] and [[Paramecia Coloniex]] mill three on entry.

scenes.head: [[Final Parting]] sets up the engine
scenes.sub: Search for two cards: one to your hand, one to your graveyard. [[Danitha, Benalia's Hope|Danitha]] goes to the graveyard, [[Kaya's Ghostform]] to your hand.

scenes.head: [[Dread Return]] brings back [[Danitha, Benalia's Hope|Danitha]]
scenes.sub: Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. As she enters, she puts [[Kaya's Ghostform|Ghostform]] from your hand onto herself.

scenes.head: Another loop, same shape
scenes.sub: Sacrifice [[Danitha, Benalia's Hope|Danitha]]. [[Kaya's Ghostform|Ghostform]] returns her. She puts Ghostform back on herself, from the graveyard this time. Repeat.

scenes.head: [[Boonweaver Giant]] is a whole engine
scenes.sub: As it enters, it can fetch an Aura from your graveyard, hand or library and attach it to itself. Take [[Kaya's Ghostform]] from your library.

scenes.head: …and it re-fetches every loop
scenes.sub: Sacrifice it, Ghostform returns it, and it finds Ghostform in your graveyard again. Seven mana is the only catch.
scenes.say: And it re-fetches every loop. Sacrifice it, Ghostform returns it, and it finds Ghostform in your graveyard again. Seven mana is the only catch.

scenes.head: [[Dimir House Guard]] does two jobs
scenes.sub: Transmute ({1}{B}{B}): find a mana value 4 card like [[Redemption Choir]]. Or cast it: 'Sacrifice a creature' makes a second free outlet.
scenes.say: [[Dimir House Guard]] does two jobs. Transmute it, for one generic and two black, to find a mana value four card like [[Redemption Choir]]. Or cast it: its sacrifice-a-creature ability makes it a second free outlet.

scenes.head: More tutors and reanimation
scenes.sub: [[Demonic Bargain]] exiles your top thirteen cards, then finds any card. [[Unburial Rites]], [[Summon Undead]] and [[Sevinne's Reclamation]] return the halves.

scenes.head: Add one payoff: [[Zulaport Cutthroat]]
scenes.sub: Whenever it or another creature you control dies, each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

scenes.head: Now every loop drains the table
scenes.sub: Each time [[Brotherhood Outcast|Outcast]] dies, every opponent loses 1 and you gain 1. [[Kaya's Ghostform|Ghostform]] and Outcast reset; repeat until they're all at zero.
scenes.say: Now every loop drains the table. Each time Outcast dies, every opponent loses one life and you gain one. Ghostform and Outcast reset, so repeat until they're all at zero.

scenes.head: Any one payoff will do
scenes.sub: [[Bastion of Remembrance]] and [[Marionette Apprentice]] drain on deaths; [[Agent of the Iron Throne]] gives Bartolomé that drain; [[Ninja Teen]] drains on leaving; [[Scavenger's Talent]] level 2 mills.

scenes.head: Or let Bartolomé win it himself
scenes.sub: Each loop adds a +1/+1 counter, so stop when he's huge. [[Rogue's Passage]]: target creature can't be blocked this turn. 21 commander damage ends a player.
scenes.say: Or let Bartolomé win it himself. Each loop adds a plus one plus one counter, so stop when he's huge. Then [[Rogue's Passage]]: target creature can't be blocked this turn. Twenty-one commander damage ends a player.

scenes.head: The hard stop: graveyard hate
scenes.sub: Every loop returns a card from your graveyard. A card that exiles graveyards or stops reanimation turns them all off.

scenes.head: Clear it before you go off
scenes.sub: [[Disenchant]] and [[Leonin Relic-Warder]] answer an artifact or enchantment. [[Generous Gift]] destroys any permanent; [[Seal from Existence]] exiles any nonland one.

scenes.head: Trap: don't feed Bartolomé your jailers
scenes.sub: When [[Leonin Relic-Warder]], [[Fiend Hunter]] or [[Werefox Bodyguard]] leaves the battlefield, the card it exiled comes back. Sacrifice something else.

scenes.head: [[Bartolomé del Presidio]] — 600 Infinite Combos
scenes.sub: One free outlet, two halves, any payoff. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
scenes.say: [[Bartolomé del Presidio]]: six hundred infinite combos. One free outlet, two halves, any payoff. The full plan is in the Plan tab.
